releaseNotes:
• The whole interface is rebuilt on a dark design system — colour now carries meaning, so present, late and absent read at a glance
• Dashboard leads with today's headline figure and tells you what still needs marking
• Attendance gains a day strip: tap a date instead of stepping through one at a time
• Payroll leads with net payable, and the month strip moves between periods in a tap
• Workers, Quick Mark, Login, Profile and the ID card all rebuilt to match
• Same data, same login — this installs straight over your current version
